# `service`

Core object · HSDS v3.2.3 · tabular file `services.csv` · [online reference](https://docs.openreferral.org/en/latest/hsds/schema_reference.html#service)

> The details of the services provided by organizations to a range of different groups.

**Required:** `id`, `name`, `status`
